title: Mixed Conditionals
summary: Mixed conditionals combine different time frames — a past condition with a present result, or vice versa.

theory.markdown:
**Mixed conditionals** combine elements from different conditional types when the time frames differ.

**Type 1 — Past condition, present result:**
**if + Past Perfect -> would + base verb**
*If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.* (I didn't take it -> so I'm not rich now)

**Type 2 — Present condition, past result:**
**if + Past Simple -> would have + past participle**
*If she were more careful, she wouldn't have made that mistake.* (She isn't careful -> so she made a mistake)

**Key tip**: Look at the time reference:
- *If I had worked harder* (past) *I would have a better job now* (present) -> Type 1
- *If he weren't so stubborn* (present) *he would have agreed* (past) -> Type 2

items.source: If I had moved to London, I would speak better English now.
items.translation: Gdybym przeprowadzil sie do Londynu, mowilbym teraz lepiej po angielsku.

items.source: If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken at the meeting.
items.translation: Gdyby nie byla taka niesmniala, zabralaeby glos na spotkaniu.

items.source: If he had listened to his doctor, he would feel better now.
items.translation: Gdyby sluchal swojego lekarza, czulby sie teraz lepiej.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (Past Perfect: study) medicine, I would be a doctor now.
exercises.explanation: Past condition -> present result. If-clause uses Past Perfect.

exercises.prompt: If she ___ (be) more organised, she wouldn't have missed the deadline.
exercises.hint: Present condition affecting past result -> Past Simple in if-clause.

exercises.source: Gdybym nauczyl sie wczesniej prowadzic, mialabym teraz prawo jazdy.
answers: If I had learnt to drive earlier, I would have a driving licence now.
If I had learned to drive earlier, I would have a driving licence now.

exercises.prompt: If they ___ (not / invest) in that company, they wouldn't be so wealthy today.
exercises.hint: Past condition -> present result. Negative if-clause.

exercises.sentence: If I would have known her earlier, we would be friends now.
answers: If I had known her earlier, we would be friends now.
exercises.explanation: Never use 'would have' in the if-clause. Use Past Perfect.

exercises.source: If he weren't so arrogant, he ___ (get) that promotion last year.
answers: If he weren't so arrogant, he would have got that promotion last year.
If he weren't so arrogant, he would have gotten that promotion last year.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is a mixed conditional (past condition, present result)?
options: If she had studied, she would have passed.
If she had studied harder, she would be a doctor now.
If she studies, she will pass.
If she were smarter, she would have passed.
exercises.explanation: Past Perfect in if-clause + 'would be now' in main clause = past condition, present result.

exercises.prompt: If he ___ (be) a morning person, he wouldn't have missed the early train.
exercises.hint: Present character trait -> past result: Past Simple in if-clause.

exercises.source: Gdybym nie studiował biologii, nie byłbym teraz w tej pracy.
answers: If I hadn't studied biology, I wouldn't be in this job now.
If I had not studied biology, I would not be in this job now.

exercises.sentence: If she was more confident, she would have got the job.
answers: If she were more confident, she would have got the job.
exercises.explanation: In formal use, 'were' is preferred for all persons in the if-clause of mixed/2nd conditionals.

exercises.prompt: If he weren't so lazy, he ___ the project on time.
exercises.explanation: Present condition -> past result: would have + past participle.

exercises.prompt: She ___ (be) healthier today if she ___ (exercise) more when she was young.
exercises.hint: Past condition -> present result: would + base verb.

exercises.instruction: Identify which mixed conditional type this is and complete it.
exercises.source: If I knew her better, I ___ (introduce) you earlier.
answers: If I knew her better, I would have introduced you earlier.

exercises.source: Gdybym wtedy nie palil, czulbym sie teraz lepiej.
answers: If I hadn't smoked then, I would feel better now.
If I hadn't been smoking then, I would feel better now.
